audit.note: Positive-only labels do not support a discriminative action classifier. Binary negatives are not action negatives without an explicit completeness review.

protocol: Fixed 30 epochs, threshold 0.7 and +/-5s point matching. No threshold or epoch selection. Source videos retain their split.
selection: Type selected by observable label coverage, before scoring the newly reviewed validation target.
limitations: Same room and actors; exploratory validation, no independent test.
Train has two points in ONE canonical positive video; validation has ONE positive video.
Three validation windows are confirmed negatives, four previously assumed negatives are now unknown.
No accounting/legal guilt inferred; no video-wide absence labels introduced.
